summary.text: Amen Brown is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 10 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Amen Brown was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
His career experience includes working as a community engagement specialist and program director with the University of Pennsylvania, as an educator, and as an entrepreneur.
Brown assumed office in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on December 1, 2022.
In the 2023-2024 session, he was assigned to the Aging and Older Adult Services, Urban Affairs and Housing, and Liquor Control committees.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
